# Accordion

> Stacked disclosure rows with measured panel animation.

This file matches the installed `accordion` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/accordion.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/accordion.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- `lucide-react@^1.78.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`
- `typography`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/accordion-knobs`: `accordionKnobs`, types `AccordionKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/accordion`: `Accordion`, `AccordionItem`, `AccordionTrigger`, `AccordionPanel`, types `AccordionValue`, `AccordionProps`, `AccordionItemProps`, `AccordionTriggerProps`, `AccordionPanelProps`

## Composition

### Anatomy

```tsx
<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem>
    <AccordionTrigger />
    <AccordionPanel />
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionPanel, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/accordion";

export function PrimitiveAccordionExample() {
  return (
    <Accordion defaultValue={["what"]} className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <AccordionItem value="what">
        <AccordionTrigger>What is Control UI?</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionPanel>
          A registry of Base UI primitives styled entirely with your theme tokens, so every surface tracks the design direction.
        </AccordionPanel>
      </AccordionItem>
      <AccordionItem value="install">
        <AccordionTrigger>How do I install a primitive?</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionPanel>
          Run the shadcn CLI against the Control UI registry and the slot lands under components/control-ui/ui.
        </AccordionPanel>
      </AccordionItem>
      <AccordionItem value="skin">
        <AccordionTrigger>Can I restyle it?</AccordionTrigger>
        <AccordionPanel>Yes — swap the theme tokens or add a skin pack; the primitive markup and behavior stay the same.</AccordionPanel>
      </AccordionItem>
    </Accordion>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `accordion`
  - `icon`
  - `item`: `data-disabled`, `data-index`, `data-open`
  - `panel`: `data-disabled`, `data-ending-style`, `data-index`, `data-open`, `data-orientation`, `data-starting-style`
  - `panel-content`
  - `root`: `data-disabled`, `data-orientation`
  - `trigger`: `data-disabled`, `data-index`, `data-panel-open`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### accordion

- `--cui-accordion-item-border-color`: `var(--border)`
- `--cui-accordion-item-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)`
- `--cui-accordion-trigger-foreground`: `var(--foreground)`
- `--cui-accordion-trigger-hover-foreground`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.8)`
- `--cui-accordion-icon-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
